last_assistant_message:
The backup web-search agent finished and largely corroborates my findings, with a few corrections worth adding to the briefing.

**Corrections / additions**

- **"George Anthony Dillon" is NOT verified.** Neither I nor the backup found that name anywhere tied to VLink or Microsoft. The email `tony.dillon@vlinkinfo.com` is real, but treat the full legal name as unconfirmed — the only confirmed identity is Anthony/"Tony" Dillon.
- **VLink has no Texas office.** A full sitemap sweep of its locations found only South Windsor, CT (HQ) and Framingham, MA in the US, plus India/Canada/Indonesia/Singapore. So his DFW location rests solely on his LinkedIn location field — don't assume VLink has local Dallas digs.
- **Additional credential detail:** certifications also include **CompTIA A+**; an older headline was "Sales Strategy & Business Development Executive | Technology Solutions Specialist | Ex Microsoft"; and he joined VLink **around 2025** (his own post: "How a recruiter helped me find my next role at VLink").
- **VLink context:** privately held, **MBE-certified minority-owned**, founded 2006, President/CEO **Sharad Patney**, Global CMO Tracy Gardner; ~644 employees (LinkedIn) with conflicting 800+ claims on its own site. Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure) is confirmed; "Azure Expert MSP" / "Data & AI" designations are company self-assertions only.
- **Golf:** still nothing personal. The only golf item is VLink's *company* sponsorship of the 2017 Travelers Championship (PGA TOUR, Cromwell CT) — do not attribute to him.

**One divergence:** the backup agent could not find the **Insight Enterprises** background, calling prior employers (beyond Microsoft) "not found." I found it directly and rate it medium-high: his own LinkedIn posts through 2023 are all Insight Microsoft-partnership content, and ContactOut still lists a prior work address `anthony.dillon@insight.com`. I'd keep it as "likely prior role at Insight" rather than dropping it.

Everything else in my briefing stands: ex-Microsoft (LinkedIn headline "Ex Microsoft" + a recommendation referencing "our time at Microsoft"), current title AVP Solution Sales & Partnership Alliance at VLink, DFW-based, and the public trail of the Sept 2025 Microsoft Solutions Partner press release, "Tech Talk with VLink" Ep. 52 podcast, and the March 2026 Azure-modernization webinar he hosted/paneled.

One caveat on process: I have no WebSearch/WebFetch of my own this session, and every search engine blocked direct curl except DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint (POST), which is where I got the confirming results.
